description: This file defines a controller class for handling 'terms' related web requests in a Perl web application, using Moose and Catalyst framework conventions. It includes actions for listing and showing terms, with navigation to previous and next terms.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Terms
classes.description: Controller class for handling 'terms' related web requests, extending Coocook::Controller.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles GET and HEAD requests to list terms, redirects to the current valid term.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Handles GET and HEAD requests to display a specific term, with navigation to previous and next terms.
